## Problem and result

What user need does this address, and what changes?

## Scope and status

State which behavior is implemented and which is proposed. Link related decisions or contract changes.

## Validation

Record the relevant checks and their results. For runtime code, include publication/permission, portability, and compatibility coverage.

## Release impact

Describe migrations, license/dependency changes, public output, and known limits. Use fictional/sanitized examples only.
